verdict.summary: Stage 4 cold review of Compass #41 against the exact Wednesday ledger (selection_coverage_wednesday_2026-09-23.json, sha256 47ef3b5a…; 208 editorial candidates, 63 selected, 145 skipped, 0 unresolved) and the bound assembled draft (2026-09-23-newsletter.md, sha256 a0fb9b47…). Scope: four hard gates, 8/10 no-zero with no item cap, selected-item effect/window/evidence/score justification, skipped items for clear false negatives, tag-bound release prose, and signed-app claims versus supplied notes. All 63 selected items meet ≥8 with no zero axis; the only failed in-window gate is top:fips-initramfs-0.1.0, which is an authenticated catch-up override and is labeled out-of-window in the draft. No skipped candidate in this snapshot has all four gates true and a qualifying score. Release prose keeps NoorNote 1.6.0/1.6.1/1.7.0, Amethyst 1.16.0, Dart NDK dev.4–dev.5, pakstr 0.21–0.24, Wisp 1.2.4, Scramble 0.7.0/0.7.2, and in-dev PRs on their own sources. XM Arcade 1.1.3 and Zzub 0.0.15 claims match the fact-checked signed notes. Limits: immutable snapshot only (no live refetch); project_activity_coverage_2026-09-23.md and raw collector JSON were not in the review packet; Armada signed-note body was not excerpted; event-example signatures were not re-verified.
